purpose: Document city-specific first-party registry evidence, service-access limits and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Mirzapur District Administration says land records are digitized and available online for Mirzapur and links UP Bhulekh. The UP Bhulekh public dashboard reports cadastral map linkage/georeferencing by tehsil; the state BhuNaksha viewer supports village-map and plot-number selection. The public viewer’s plot lookup is keyed by GIS/village code plus plot number and may return plot details; without a verified full-geometry response schema, no parcel-specific request or sample was retained.

serviceChecks.method: GET official public viewer shell and static JS review
serviceChecks.observed: HTTP 200. Viewer exposes location selectors District/Tehsil/Village and plot number. Static client references levelvalue, getVVVVExtentGeoref, getPlotAtXY, getPlotByPlotNo, and getPlotInfo routes; plot lookups require selected GIS/village code and plot number. No parcel request was made and no full vector response schema was verified.
Dashboard lists digitized/georeferenced cadastral maps by Mirzapur tehsil; these aggregate counts do not establish the WUP-centroid parcel.
